title: Ogres frighten Seetha
introduction: This chapter describes the ogre women speaking to Seetha about her marrying Ravana.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयोविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 23rd Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः |
संदिश्य च ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्निर्जगाम ह
verses.iast:
ityuktvā maithilīṃ rājā rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ |
sandiśya ca tataḥ sarvā rākṣasīrnirjagāma ha
verses.translation: The king Ravana who makes enemies to cry thus speaking to Seetha thereafter also ordering all ogre women went away.

verses.devanagari:
निष्क्रन्ते राक्षसेन्द्र तु पुनरन्तःपुरं गते |
राक्षस्यो भीमरूपास्ताः सीतां समभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
niṣkrante rākṣasendra tu punarantaḥpuraṃ gate |
rākṣasyo bhīmarūpāstāḥ sītāṃ samabhidudruvuḥ
verses.translation: After Ravana left and obtained gynaeceum, those ogres with horrible appearances went running to Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्चिताः |
परं पुरुषया वाचा वैदेहीमिदमब्रवन्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrcitāḥ |
paraṃ puruṣayā vācā vaidehīmidamabravan
verses.translation: Thereafter reaching Seetha ogre women swooned with anger and with a very harsh speech spoke these words to Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
पौलस्त्यस्य वरिष्ठस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः |
दशग्रीवस्य भार्यात्वं सीते न बहुमन्यसे
verses.iast:
paulastyasya variṣṭhasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
daśagrīvasya bhāryātvaṃ sīte na bahumanyase
verses.translation: "O Seetha! You are not respscting becoming wife of Ravana born in the family of Paulastya, best among men, a great soul with ten heads."

glosses.meaning: born in the family of Paulastya

verses.devanagari:
ततस्वएकजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
अमन्त्य्र क्रोधताम्राक्षी सीतां करतलोदरीम्
verses.iast:
tatasvaekajaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt |
amantyra krodhatāmrākṣī sītāṃ karatalodarīm
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Ekajata with red eyes sue to anger calling Seetha with stomach that can be held by palm of the hand, spoke these words.

glosses.meaning: with red eyes due to anger
with stomach that can be held by a palm of the hand

verses.devanagari:
प्रजापतीनाम् षण्णं तु चतुर्थो यः प्रजापतिः |
मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्य इति विश्रुतः
verses.iast:
prajāpatīnām ṣaṇṇaṃ tu caturtho yaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ pulastya iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: "Among th six Prajapatis, whichever son, the fourth Prajapati, born by the thought of Lord Brahma ,he is famous as Paulastya."

verses.devanagari:
पुलस्त्यस्य तु तेजस्वी महार्षिर्मानसः सुतः |
नाम्ना स विश्रवा नाम प्रजापतिसमप्रभः
verses.iast:
pulastyasya tu tejasvī mahārṣirmānasaḥ sutaḥ |
nāmnā sa viśravā nāma prajāpatisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: By the name, famous as Visrava, with a radiance equalling that of Lord Brahmathat glorious sage is the son born from the thought of Pulastya.

glosses.meaning: with a radiance equalling that of Lord Brahma

verses.devanagari:
तस्य पुत्रो विशालाक्षि रावणः शत्रुरावणः |
तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि
मयोक्तं चारुसर्वाङ्गि वाक्यम् किं नाममन्यसे |
verses.iast:
tasya putro viśālākṣi rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ |
tasya tvaṃ rākṣasendrasya bhāryā bhavitumarhasi
mayoktaṃ cārusarvāṇ^gi vākyam kiṃ nāmamanyase |
verses.translation: "O wide eyed one! Ravana who makes enemies to cry, is Visrava's son. You are suited to become Ravana's wife. O one with all beautiful limbs! Why will you not agree words spoken by me."

glosses.meaning: O one with all beautiful limbs!

verses.devanagari:
ततो हरिजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्
विवर्त्य नयने कोपान्मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा |
verses.iast:
tato harijaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt
vivartya nayane kopānmārjārasadṛśekṣaṇā |
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Harijata with eyes like those of a cat turned around eyes due to anger and spoke these words.

glosses.meaning: with eyes like those of a cat

verses.devanagari:
येन देवास्त्रायस्त्रिंशद्देवराजश्च निर्जताः
तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
yena devāstrāyastriṃśaddevarājaśca nirjatāḥ
tasya tvaṃ rākṣasendrasya bhāryā bhavitumarhasi |
verses.translation: "By whom thirty three Devas and the king of Devas have been conquered, you are suited to become the wife of that lord of ogres.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता
भर्त्सयनी तदा घोरमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tatastu praghasā nāma rākṣasī krodhamūrchitā
bhartsayanī tadā ghoramidaṃ vacanamabravīt |
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre named Praghasa swooning with anger and then frightening Seetha, spoke this horrible word.

verses.devanagari:
वीर्योत्सिक्तस्य शूरस्य सम्ग्रामे न निवर्तिनः
बलिनो वीर्ययुक्तस्य भार्यात्वम् किं न लप्स्यसे |
verses.iast:
vīryotsiktasya śūrasya samgrāme na nivartinaḥ
balino vīryayuktasya bhāryātvam kiṃ na lapsyase |
verses.translation: "Why will you not get wifehood of Ravana who is proud of his might, valiant, who will not turn back in wars, who is strong together with valour."

verses.devanagari:
प्रियां बहुमतां भार्यां त्यक्त्वा राजा महाबलः
सर्वासां च महाभागां त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः |
verses.iast:
priyāṃ bahumatāṃ bhāryāṃ tyaktvā rājā mahābalaḥ
sarvāsāṃ ca mahābhāgāṃ tvāmupaiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "The mighty Ravana can leave dear respectable wife who among all wives is most fortunate and can obtain you."

verses.devanagari:
समृद्धम् स्त्रीसहस्रेण नानारत्नोपशोभितम्
अन्तःपुरं समुत्सृज्य त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः |
verses.iast:
samṛddham strīsahasreṇa nānāratnopaśobhitam
antaḥpuraṃ samutsṛjya tvāmupaiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "Ravana leaving gynaeceum filled with thousand women and shone by various best things can obtain you.

verses.devanagari:
अन्या तु विकटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्
असकृद्देवता युद्धे नागगन्धर्वदानवाः |
निर्जिताः समरे येन सते पार्श्वमुपागतः
verses.iast:
anyā tu vikaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt
asakṛddevatā yuddhe nāgagandharvadānavāḥ |
nirjitāḥ samare yena sate pārśvamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Another ogre woman named Vikata spoke these words: "By whom a number of times in war Devas, in war Nagas, Gandharvas and Danavas have been conquered that Ravana has come to your side."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य सर्वसमृद्धस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः |
किमद्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्यात्वं नेच्छऽधमे
verses.iast:
tasya sarvasamṛddhasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ |
kimadya rākṣasendrasya bhāryātvaṃ neccha'dhame
verses.translation: "O vile one! Why are you not desiring wifehood of such Ravana, fulfilled in all respects, who is a great soul and lord of ogres.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु दुर्मुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् |
यस्य सूर्यो न तपति भीतो यस्य च मारुतः
न वाति स्मायतापाङ्गे किं त्वं तस्य न तिष्ठसि |
verses.iast:
tatastu durmukhī nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt |
yasya sūryo na tapati bhīto yasya ca mārutaḥ
na vāti smāyatāpāṇ^ge kiṃ tvaṃ tasya na tiṣṭhasi |
verses.translation: Thereafter an ogre woman named Durmukhi spoke these words: " O one with long eyes! Fearing whom the sun will not comsume by heat, fearing whom the win will not blow, to that one why are you not favourable."

glosses.meaning: O one with long cornered eyes! bhiitaH = fearing

verses.devanagari:
पुष्टवृष्टं च तरवो मुमुचुर्यस्य वै भयात्
शैलाश्च सुभ्रु पानीयम् जलदाश्च यदेच्छति |
तस्य नैरृतराजस्य राजराजस्य भामिनि
किं त्वं न कुरुषे बुद्धिं भार्यार्थे रावणस्य हि |
verses.iast:
puṣṭavṛṣṭaṃ ca taravo mumucuryasya vai bhayāt
śailāśca subhru pānīyam jaladāśca yadecchati |
tasya nairṛtarājasya rājarājasya bhāmini
kiṃ tvaṃ na kuruṣe buddhiṃ bhāryārthe rāvaṇasya hi |
verses.translation: "O one with good eyebrows! O Seetha! By the fear of whom trees shed a shower of flowers, whenever Ravana desired mountains and clouds will shed water, why you are not making mind to be the wife of such Ravana, who is the king of ogres and king of kings."

verses.devanagari:
साधु ते तत्त्वतो देवि कथितं साधु भामिनि
गृहाण सुस्मिते वाक्यमन्यथा न भविष्यसि |
verses.iast:
sādhu te tattvato devi kathitaṃ sādhu bhāmini
gṛhāṇa susmite vākyamanyathā na bhaviṣyasi |
verses.translation: "O Seetha with a good smile! O princess! Understand kind words spoken to you well and truly."
